item.title: Effective Python Sentence Splitting Techniques Compared
item.description:
“Effective Python Sentence Splitting Techniques Compared”

How does one reliably segment a block of text into its constituent sentences in Python, especially when facing tricky edge cases like abbreviations (e.g., “Mr.”, “U.S.A.”), numerical decimals, or acronyms? Various strategies exist, leveraging external libraries or intricate regular expressions. Let’s examine effective solutions presented for this common natural language processing task.

Library-Based Approaches for Sentence Segmentation

External libraries often provide pre-trained models or highly refined logic to handle linguistic complexities better than simple pattern matching.

item.title: Top 10 Methods to Compute Similarity Between Two Text Documents
item.description:
Introduction

In the realm of Natural Language Processing (NLP), determining the degree of similarity between two documents is a crucial task. There are various methodologies to achieve this, each with its strengths and applicability depending on the use case. This guide delves into ten different approaches to compute text similarity, tailoring solutions in Python and using established libraries.

Method 1: TF-IDF with Cosine Similarity

The Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) method leverages the frequency of words to establish similarity, while cosine similarity quantifies the angle between two vectors.
